# Codex Musica

> A static, server-free catalog of recording "recipes" for 1090 recorded-music
> traditions and 421 instruments. Each tradition resolves to a compressed
> descriptor-stack recipe (how to record a song in that style) plus a structured
> arrangement (ensemble, room, signal chain, tuning). All data is plain JSON served as
> static files — open a URL and read it. No API key, no server, no rate limit.

## How to use (for agents)
- List of traditions: https://weningerii.github.io/CodexMusica/api/traditions/index.json
- One tradition (recipe + arrangement): https://weningerii.github.io/CodexMusica/api/traditions/{id}.json
- List of instruments: https://weningerii.github.io/CodexMusica/api/instruments/index.json
- One instrument: https://weningerii.github.io/CodexMusica/api/instruments/{id}.json
- Catalog root / endpoint map: https://weningerii.github.io/CodexMusica/api/index.json

Each tradition file has: id, name, family, lineage, recipe (string, <=1000 chars),
recipe_chars, score, and config (the structured arrangement). Fetch the index to get
every {id}, then fetch the per-id file you need.

## Catalog
- [Catalog index](https://weningerii.github.io/CodexMusica/api/index.json)
- [Traditions index](https://weningerii.github.io/CodexMusica/api/traditions/index.json)
- [Instruments index](https://weningerii.github.io/CodexMusica/api/instruments/index.json)
- [Agent guide](https://weningerii.github.io/CodexMusica/AGENTS.md)
